description: Root scope encompassing the core TERI AI RAG application service, operational evaluation and backfill scripts, end-to-end ingestion audit tools, and post-ingest reporting artifacts and chat UI.

components.name: Core Application Service
components.description: Implements the core RAG platform, encompassing REST APIs, document ingestion pipelines, hybrid retrieval, knowledge extraction, graph synchronization, and catalog storage.

components.name: Retrieval and Search Engine
components.description: Executes hybrid, structured, and graph retrieval strategies and builds consolidated prompt contexts from search results.

components.name: Document Ingestion Pipeline
components.description: Coordinates document ingestion, change detection, text segmentation, date resolution, and vector indexing.

components.name: Knowledge Graph Extraction
components.description: Extracts factual claims, evaluates entity candidates, and projects verified claims into the knowledge graph.

components.name: Catalog and Metadata Store
components.description: Manages persistent document state, metadata queries, assertion history, and taxonomy mapping in SQL storage.

components.name: API and Workflow Orchestration
components.description: Exposes HTTP API endpoints, orchestrates query answering pipelines, and runs background worker tasks.

components.name: Core Clients and Data Models
components.description: Provides shared client connections to databases, vector stores, LLMs, caches, and core document models.

components.name: Observability and Retrieval Logging
components.description: Collects metrics, application traces, and structured step-by-step retrieval execution logs.

components.name: Application Configuration and Bootstrap
components.description: Defines environment configuration settings, application factories, and service entrypoints.

components.name: Operational and Evaluation Scripts
components.description: Provides maintenance scripts, benchmarks, backfill utilities, and offline evaluations for catalog data, date resolution, knowledge graphs, and retrieval performance.

components.name: Administrative Maintenance Utilities
components.description: One-off administrative and maintenance scripts for Drupal crawling, corpus reprocessing, graph index management, and facet migrations.

components.name: Metadata and Facet Backfill Utilities
components.description: Backfills missing or legacy document attributes including author names, dates, provenance, edition labels, and tag facets.

components.name: Information Retrieval Evaluation
components.description: Evaluates retrieval performance, entity recognition, date resolution, and entity extraction precision against ground truth datasets.

components.name: Catalog and Promotion Auditing
components.description: Audits dates, annual report timestamps, manual overrides, and PI promotions across the catalog to identify discrepancies.

components.name: Chat and Retrieval Benchmarking
components.description: Runs automated chat evaluation and retrieval grading benchmarks against graph-routed queries.

components.name: Date Version Comparison
components.description: Compares date versioning behaviors and scrapes live site timestamps for cross-version validation.

components.name: Shadow Corpus Reporting
components.description: Generates shadow corpus analysis reports and prototypes date extraction heuristics across PDF samples.

components.name: Knowledge Layer Orchestration
components.description: Orchestrates construction of the knowledge layer, entity disambiguation, and knowledge document generation.

components.name: Vector Index Management
components.description: Provisions and ensures full-text and payload indexes across vector store collections.

components.name: Orphaned Document Recovery
components.description: Recovers empty attachment parents and stranded catalog records in the document hierarchy.

components.name: Catalog Schema Migration
components.description: Applies schema migrations and renames themes or legacy catalog tables in the database.

components.name: Catalog Verification
components.description: Verifies document counts and corpus consistency across catalog stores and vector databases.

components.description: Executes end-to-end ingestion audits, date resolution replay, knowledge run verification, and local database consistency checks.

components.name: End-to-End Ingestion Audit
components.description: Executes isolated end-to-end ingestion audit runs across MySQL, Qdrant, and Neo4j, performing cross-stage consistency checks and generating verification reports.

components.name: Local Ingestion Test Diagnostics
components.description: Captures, inspects, serializes, and formats local ingestion pipeline outputs and catalog snapshots for verification reporting.

components.name: Audit Reports and UI Client
components.description: Supplies post-ingestion validation reports cross-checking catalog and vector store representations alongside the embeddable chat UI widget.
